prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Returning to Your Pet?", "If you already adopted a pet on another device, restore your account here.", "Restore Existing Account", "Create New Pet Account"]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Sign Certificate"]
2: ["Your Pet is Being Prepared", "An audio chime will sound when your pet is ready."]
3: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Start Playing"]
4: ["Pet Crafting Progress", "Generating pet artwork and desktop behaviors..."]
5: ["Sign In to Desktop Pet", "Log in to retrieve your existing pets and settings.", "Account Pet Recovery Active"]
6: ["Hover over any companion to preview desktop idle animations.", "Each companion features unique idle routines."]
7: ["Right-click your pet or click the system tray icon to control or hide.", "Hotkey: Press Alt+P to summon or dismiss your pet anytime."]
8: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Complete onboarding to receive a free starter desktop accessory.", "Includes Free Starter Accessory"]
9: ["Signing in secures your pet state in cloud backup so your companion is never reset.", "Cloud Pet Protection Enabled"]
